versions.content: AUTOSAR non - volatile memory functionality shall secure integrity of memory blocks Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR non - volatile memory handling shall be able to detect corrupted memory data and act appropriately . This could be achieved e. g. by error correction data or saving the data to multiple redundant memory areas together with a suitable data digest, identifying data correctness.
